find:
paths = [...await names(["diff-tree", "-r", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-z", from.commit, target]),
      ...await names(["log", "--no-renames", "--diff-merges=separate", "--name-only", "--format=", "-z", range])];
test: node --test --test-name-pattern='reproducer: a migration in an earlier commit' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the change set is measured from the installed release, not from the target commit's own parent

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='added and reverted inside the update' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: every commit in the range counts, so a migration added and reverted inside one update is still a change

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='any file under the updater DDL directory' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the updater's fixed DDL is applied by the release schema phase, which a non-fresh install does not run

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='any file under the updater DDL directory' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the grants, role manifest, ledger and queue data the release schema phase reads live in deploy/postgres

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='database path rule' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: any .sql file is a database change, matching the referee's classes.json database patterns

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='database path rule' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: APFS folds case, so DB/x lands in db/ and must classify like it

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='not an ancestor of the target, or is unknown' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: an installed commit that is unknown or not related to the target proves nothing and fails closed

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='not an ancestor of the target, or is unknown' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: git's exit 1 means not an ancestor; only exit 0 proves the installed commit is in the target's history

test: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='classified from the installed commit' tests/updater-referee.test.ts
why: the referee diffs from the installed release's commit, never from the candidate's own parent

test: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='attended install gate counts every path' tests/updater-referee.test.ts
why: the attended install gate is never looser than the referee's database rule (role-manifest generator included)

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='a stop while the ancestry question is asked' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a stop or timeout during the ancestry check is reported as itself, never turned into a history answer

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='reproducer: a shallow side parent' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a shallow mirror can drop a merge's side history while the installed commit is still an ancestor

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='shallow, grafted or replaced' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a replace ref can rewrite a commit's parents and hide history from the range walk

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='shallow, grafted or replaced' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a grafts file can cut a commit's parents and hide history from the range walk

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='written while the classifier asks about ancestry' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: ancestry alone is not proof of complete history; the completeness check must run before the range walk

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='disagrees with its own release directory' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: only the attended release builder writes an installed manifest; any other record is not the installed release

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='disagrees with its own release directory' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the installed manifest must name the release its own directory was built for, or the update is classified from the wrong commit

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='rewritten to claim the offered commit' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a manifest claiming the offered commit under the installed directory would skip the database gate; the commit is bound, not only the version

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='disagrees with its own release directory' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the installed version decides downgrade consent, so it is bound to the release directory too

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='added by one merge and removed by another' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: git log lists no paths for merge commits by default; a database input that only merges add and remove is still a change

find: if (!await mirrorHistoryCompleteV1(mirror, args => git(input, tools.git, mirror, args))) refuse("updater_mirror_history_refused");
test: node --test --test-name-pattern='a graft cannot put a commit main never had' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a graft, replace ref or shallow boundary can make a commit main never had look like main's ancestor at fetch admission

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='a graft cannot manufacture ancestry' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: a fetch through a grafted mirror would fast-forward the trusted main ref to an unrelated commit before any ancestry check

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='a graft cannot manufacture ancestry' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the existing-plan ancestry check asks the same mirror and must not trust fabricated parents

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='replace ref or a shallow boundary' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the watcher shares the classifier's completeness rule: a shallow mirror proves no admission

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='replace ref or a shallow boundary' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the watcher shares the classifier's completeness rule: a replace ref proves no admission

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='a graft cannot manufacture ancestry' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the watcher shares the classifier's completeness rule: a grafts file fabricates ancestry

find:
if (!await complete()) refuse("updater_mirror_history_refused");
    try { await git(session.input, session.tools.git, session.mirror, ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", from.commit, session.commit]); }
replace: try { await git(session.input, session.tools.git, session.mirror, ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", from.commit, session.commit]); }
test: node --test --test-name-pattern='graft written after classification' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: an incomplete mirror is never asked whether the installed commit is an ancestor; its answer could waive downgrade consent

find:
catch { downgrade = true; }
    if (!await complete()) refuse("updater_mirror_history_refused");
test: node --test --test-name-pattern='graft written after classification' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: a graft written while the downgrade ancestry question is asked is caught after it, so the answer is refused

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: a watcher refused for untrusted history holds every update, so the hold must be recorded for the owner

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the hold clears on the next successful watcher tick, so a repaired mirror does not keep a stale attention item

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: a held update needs the owner: needsYou is what turns the card red

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the held card carries its plain sentence, not silence

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: a held update is an attention item, not a quiet idle card

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='held by untrusted history' tests/updater-watcher.test.mjs
why: the hold has no reviewed action; the derived review_recovery would send the owner to a recovery that never happened

test: node --test --test-name-pattern='shallow, grafted or replaced mirror proves nothing' tests/updater-attended-source.test.mjs
why: the classifier never asks an incomplete mirror about ancestry
